query: WITH entities AS (SELECT id FROM workflow_definitions WHERE provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1 AND deleted = FALSE) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $2 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN workflow_definition_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id, e.sequence
